summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py: it runs a callback (sync or async, with args/kwargs) in the app's event loop from a worker thread and blocks until it returns the result. It raises RuntimeError if the app isn't running or if called from the app's own thread (deadlock guard). The loop is recorded in _process_messages. Added tests/test_call_from_thread.py. Verification: the sync test passes under pytest with PYTHONPATH=src; the three async tests fail under pytest only because the venv lacks an async plugin (existing async tests fail the same way), but their bodies pass when run directly with asyncio.run. Note the venv imports textual from tasks/.../base, not this repo, so PYTHONPATH=src was required. No commit made.
